label: check054
claim: One/seven/thirty-day screens reproduce; R12 ISA FOIL30 is +47.344558 kg, and installed service remains unqualified.
source_report_body:
CHECK-054 complete: main numerical conclusions reproduce; QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION throughout. No owner executable opened, hashed, imported or run.

R10 ISA SiOx/3A dry beads for 1/7/30 days: 4.414369/17.164891/60.355531 kg. Seven-day capture system 27.233891 kg plus barrier 2.513274 leaves +1.115544 kg; thirty days leaves −55.428312 kg. At 333 K the source isotherm supports 6.09854 wt% after stated reserves, hence the conditional 6% screen. Peak heat 16.539181 W and effective water conductance 277.02258 m³/h reproduce.

Seven-/thirty-day WVTR budgets are 0.085508511/0.016136312 g/m²/day against the 0.08 coupon. Aramid SF and UHMWPE creep screens reproduce. A source-conditioned 3.5% aramid-moisture sensitivity changes no payload or 1/7/30-day pressure pass.

61,318 primary value checks; all 2,816 tiny cold-input precision differences reconcile exactly within tolerance. 54,857 supplemental checks cover CSVs, 275 displayed card values, decimal isotherms and balances. One report-only rounding fix: R12 ISA FOIL30 +47.35 → +47.34 kg (exact 47.34455788658644); card already correct. Hardware-volume conventions need documentation.

All 16 owner and 15 inherited NFIs retained; three checker records filed. 87 owner non-code input pins verified; one executable entry excluded. 192 delivery checks pass. No installed qualification gained. No successor; ending turn.
numerical_scope: Synthesis of attributed reports; consult named check/review findings for numerical disposition
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
